summary: 50-year-old Colorado woman took a 40- to 50-foot fall on the north side of Deer Mountain while hiking with a family member; rangers reached her just after 8 p.m. and determined she did not survive; her body was found in steep, rocky terrain about three miles from the Deer Mountain trailhead, flown out the following afternoon, and turned over to the county coroner.
location: North side of Deer Mountain, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: NPS Rocky Mountain National Park rangers
